Category: Multimorphic Add-On Game Software
Sorcerer’s Apprentice is a magic-inspired add-on gaming experience for the P 3 pinball platform and the Cosmic Cart Racing playfield module (each sold separately). Full game intro You play the game as the apprentice, and the ultimate goal is to defeat the sorcerer in a battle of magic. Gameplay has you traveling to different environments and playing modes to learn spells, collect keys, and find/open chests. Travel through distant lands and learn magical spells. This game is perfectly conceived for the Cosmic Cart Racing playfield module because of its flowing/exploratory layout and density of 900 RGB LEDs. The main playfield display content immerses you into gameplay, and screen effects combined with incredible lightshows deliver the magical experience you’d expect from a sorcerer-centric theme. Enjoy dazzling lightshows. Because Sorcerer’s Apprentice is based on casting and fending off spells, managing your health is a big part of the game. There are a few different ways to lose health and a couple of ways to gain it back, which is important because when your health reaches 0%, the flippers go dead, and the ball ends. Combine spells for bigger rewards but also bigger risk. Each environment has 4 different modes, including a multiball mode, and there’s another stackable, overarching multiball mode: Black Magic Multiball! Along the way, you’ll encounter bandits that try to steal your belongings and magical wards that attack you. Perfect your spell management during multiballs! Learn everything you can from the master sorcerer and then try to defeat him in battle! For an even more immersive experience, add the Sorcerer’s Apprentice Apron Magnet (sold separately).
